race.comment: BIDEN TIME (1) built on a nice third two starts back at this track with success as favourite over 1600m at this track five days ago, scoring with ease. Going well and looks tough to beat again. MERIMBULA (2) has been safely held last two but both in feature races, the latest the Darwin Cup. Coming back in trip and class. Gets chance to find some form. Same goes for GRINZINGER TUNDRA (10) who finds it hard to win but will find this easier than the Darwin Cup last time. This more suitable and likely to play a big role. AGGRESSIVE (6) also ran in the Cup, settling well back before stoking up nicely in the straight to finish fourth. Should prove tough to hold out. FABERGE TZAR (5) is working up to a win. Close here last week and looks for a bold showing expected.
